svg.text: Native American warrior — the whole look and its ornaments
Scope (R-4151): ONLY the garment boxes. The figure under them is the existing block figure, drawn for context and unchanged. Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app.
Native American warrior — the whole look
black hair, a braid each side, headband + feathers, face paint,
buckskin + yoke, breastplate, armbands, necklace, beaded belt
a band of small coloured squares — blue, red, white, yellow —
across the chest and over the shoulders of the buckskin, front
a bone breastplate: six vertical rows of white tubes between
two leather bars, over the shirt (worn over or instead of the
a red band with a blue stripe round each upper arm
a white bead collar round the neck, a strand of coloured beads
on the chest, a yellow pendant
